preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the permutation N must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of good indices K must be between 1 and N.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if K > N else True
postconditions.description: If K is greater than N, output -1 indicating no valid permutation exists.

postconditions.expression: len(P) == N and sum(1 for i in range(1, N + 1) if P[i - 1] % i == 0) == K
postconditions.description: The output permutation P must have length N and exactly K good indices.
